The '''overrun mining path''' was a road in [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] that led to a nearby [[lanthanide mine]], but was overrun by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ascercia]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Virne]] were stationed in the area at one point around [[3643 BBY]].
